chunks: Al-Rayyān ibn al-Ṣalt narrated from someone who informed him, from Abī al-Ḥasan عليه السلام, who said:
Whoever uses nūrah on the day of al-Jumuʿah and is afflicted with leprosy, then let him blame none but himself.

key_terms.الْبَرَصُ: leprosy or a severe skin affliction
key_terms.تَنَوَّرَ: used nūrah, a depilatory substance for hair removal

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith say about using nūrah on Friday?
ai.summary: This hadith warns against using nūrah on Friday and presents an adverse consequence for doing so. It reflects guidance on bodily care and etiquette connected to the day of al-Jumuʿah within transmitted Shia hadith literature.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.268 - Al-Rayyan ibn Al-Salt narrated from someone, who narrated from Abu Al-Hasan, Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim (as), said:
"Whoever puts on Nuura (depilatory paste) on Jumu’ah and is afflicted with leprosy, let him blame no one but himself."
